SpecVocab.finding: Low-dimensional approximate vocabulary logits, top-k selection, then exact rescoring are already its core method. It trains the ranking module jointly with the drafter; fixed k is used in experiments while variable k is acknowledged.

SlimSpec.finding: Low-rank draft output heads retaining full vocabulary are prior work. Do not claim either low-rank compression or candidate rescoring itself as novel.

decision: Do not start an ungrounded low-rank branch yet. v59 indicates acceptance is the primary gap; test broader online retention with a matched prompt-only control.
